newsitem.title: USA: Colorado grants UPS restraining order.
newsitem.headline: Colorado grants UPS restraining order.

text.p: A state court in Colorado has granted a 10-day temporary restraining order to UPS, preventing striking workers from harassing UPS workers and limiting the number of strikers on picket lines, a court clerk said Thursday.
The order was granted in Adams County court in Brighton, Colo., on Wednesday, the clerk said.
The order limits the number of pickets to 20 at each gate at the UPS operation in Commerce City, which is in Adams County where the order was issued.
The order also prohibits pickets from threatening, harassing or intimidating UPS workers and customers of UPS who come into the plant, the clerk said.

UPS has sought court orders in other states to prevent striking workers from interfering with company operations, the company said. At least 15 striking workers have been arrested and several have been injured, including a police officer, in clashes at UPS facilities in the Boston area in recent days.
